task_description: Round 4: structural entry+exit redesign of GaganEA.mq5 (v2.11 -> v2.12) to attack the negative edge (PF 0.58 < 1, avg loss 1.23 > avg win 0.70). Replace the low-conviction pattern-zoo entry gate with a confluence gate (HTF+CTF trend agreement + ATR volatility-regime filter + EMA-pullback-and-resume with RSI confirmation + session/hour filter) and add optional ATR-based dynamic SL/TP enforcing a core reward:risk >= ~1.5 so winners can structurally exceed losers, while keeping the conservative-DD posture (Risk_Percent 1.0, concurrent cap, real stops). New logic is additive/reversible via master switches. Version bumped to 2.12. Append a Round 4 entry to ITERATION_LOG.md. The 11 tuner-managed inputs keep exact names/types. This is an experiment: no performance measurable in-sandbox; no invented numbers; compile+backtest validated by the user's next MT5 run.
